systems.system: e-Justice-CM, on the RJ-Secure judicial network
systems.owner: Ministry of Justice, with USD 10 million from the African Development Bank
systems.tiers: 42 court registries with terminals linked to RJ-Secure, against a goal of 60 by the end of 2025; a courts' system, with no link to the police or gendarmerie stated

note: On justice reform since 2018; the one system is the courts' registry computerisation, which is the courts' case management and not a police system, and the document states no link from it to the police. States nothing about station records.
